Assalamu Alaikum I am a Hafiz Alhamdulillah, but I have problem pronouncing the Ra sound. There is a joint below the tip of my tongue, which makes my tongue tip-less and I cannot make the Ra sound. Whenever I try to pronounce Ra, the sound of Waw comes out. I have tried a lot of time when I was small, and when I was doing Hifz but it did not improve. Now since I am a Hafiz, I am usually asked to lead the prayer when the Imam is not present in the Masjid. I want to ask whether it is ok if I lead the prayer? I cannot even pronounce Allahu Akbar properly. The sound comes out as Allahu Akbaw, but people usually don't notice. And then there will be many more mistakes in Surah Fatihah. So is my prayer valid? And what about the prayer of those who are praying behind me? I heard one 'Alim say that if Takbeere Tahreema is not proper, then a person will not even enter into the prayer. It is as if he has not started the prayer at all. What should I do then? I cannot pronounce it properly. I hope Allah will accept my prayer because I am ma'zoor, but if I am leading the prayer, will the prayer of those behind me be valid? Jazakallah Khair 2924 views Q. I have pet cats. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 159354 Country: Bangladesh Title: My question is every day I will miss the Fajr prayer, salah. Now, this time what can I do? Question: My question is every day I will miss the Fajr prayer, salah. Now, this time what can I do? Answer ID: 159354 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 664/607/M=6/1439) Go to bed early after Isha. Go to bed with the intention that you will have to get up in each condition whether your heart is not ready and think that whoever misses his one salah is as his family and wealth is looted. If possible, ask your namazi neighbour that he awakens you in the morning for salah or you sleep by setting alarm so that you get up on time. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
